1.title: Act I · A Job, a Tankard and a Toll

venues.name: Welcome to Brindle Quay
venues.text: Brindle Quay. A city built on trade, tides, and the firm belief that somebody else will pay for repairs. Somewhere in these crooked streets, there must be work for a chartmaker.

venues.name: The Crooked Compass
venues.text: The Crooked Compass. Warm food, sailors with stories, and probably somebody who needs a map. An excellent place to start, particularly the warm food part.

venues.name: Quibble’s Crossing
venues.text: Quibble's Crossing connects the tavern streets to the harbour. Apparently the toll collector accepts sharp wit. At last, a currency I haven't already spent.

closing.text: Here I am, at the Crooked Compass. Time to put this city on my map, and some supper on my plate.

venues.name: Repair Quay
venues.text: Repair Quay. My investigation starts among patched hulls and honest tools. Boats may leak, but at least they admit it.

venues.name: The Quay Quill
venues.text: The Quay Quill prints the local news. I need a reliable timeline. Preferably one written before the editor discovers how much more exciting tomorrow sounds.

venues.name: Rook House
venues.text: Rook House. Somewhere behind that respectable front door is the maker of our mysterious mechanism. I hope getting answers is simpler than getting breakfast.

venues.name: Blind Inlet
venues.text: Blind Inlet hides behind the cliffs. A good place to identify a suspicious ship, provided I can distinguish suspicious from merely expensive.

venues.name: Fair Passage Survey Office
venues.text: The Fair Passage Survey Office. Where measurements become official. I intend to find out whether the truth still fits once they've put it on company stationery.

closing.text: Here I am at Repair Quay. Three leads, one pencil, and a harbour full of people who would rather I used neither.
